home_intro: An open-source phonetic transcription tool supporting character-by-character and phrase-based translation for linguists, learners, and researchers.
home_feat1_desc: Zero data leaves your device. All translations are calculated directly in your browser for maximum privacy and instant speed.
home_feat2_desc: Extensive support for a wide range of languages, utilizing highly accurate romanization and IPA conversion tables.
home_feat3_desc: Built for the community. Inspect the code, contribute to the translation tables, or run it entirely offline.
home_agent_desc: Not a human user? Use agent.html— query via URL parameters, get plain text IPA back. No UI overhead, no installation, fewer tokens. Works with agent-browser, Playwright, Puppeteer, and any JS-capable browser tool.
home_footer_desc: This open-source project translates text from various languages to International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) notation. It uses IPA databases and romanization conversion tables to provide accurate phonetic transcriptions.
